title: Hedge reduction for a Sidney condo

seo.title: Sample project: Sidney condo hedge reduction | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: an overgrown laurel and cedar hedge at a Sidney condo reduced in stages, within Town tree rules and with neighbours told first. Free quote.

summary: An overgrown boundary hedge reduced in stages over two seasons.
story: The hedge had grown over the sidewalk and shaded ground-floor units.
We checked the Town's rules, then reduced the hedge in two stages so it would green up again rather than leave bare stems. Neighbours got notice before work.
Read more about [tree and vegetation work](/services/tree-vegetation/), see our work in [Sidney](/areas/sidney/), or [get a free quote](/quote/).
result: Sidewalk cleared and the hedge kept as a screen.
